questions.question: Why does the lighthouse lamp not turn on the first cold morning?
questions.answer: The lighthouse clock has stopped, so the lamp does not turn

questions.question: What is the keeper's rule in Kessel?
questions.answer: The keeper's rule: the lamp turns on the clock's hour, and a keeper who breaks it loses the tower

questions.question: How does Tomas react when Ines says somebody stopped the clock?
questions.answer: Tomas says nothing when Ines says that somebody stopped the clock

questions.question: What will happen to Ines's father if the clock is not running by Friday?
questions.answer: Mr Hale warns that the keeper will lose the tower unless the clock runs by Friday

questions.question: How does Ines pay the clockmaker, and why?
questions.answer: Ines pays Ada with her mother's brass compass, because she cannot pay Ada's price

questions.question: Who holds the key to the clock room at the end of the chapter?
questions.answer: Ada holds the key to the clock room, the first person outside the family to hold it

questions.question: Why did the lighthouse clock stop?
questions.answer: Somebody opened the case with the key and packed salt into the main wheel, so the clock did not stop by chance

questions.question: Who borrowed the clock-room key from Tomas, and what did Tomas get?
questions.answer: Tomas lent the key to Mr Hale for one evening, for a silver coin

questions.question: What happens when Ada has mended the clock?
questions.answer: The mended clock strikes at noon, so the lamp turns and the boats come in

questions.question: What does Ines do with the key after Mr Hale asks for it?
questions.answer: Ines will not give Mr Hale the key and hides it in the base of the kitchen lamp

questions.question: What does Ada do with the salt?
questions.answer: Ada stays in Kessel to mend the church clock and keeps the salt

questions.question: What does Ines wonder about the harbour master at the end?
questions.answer: Ines does not know why the harbour master wants her father out of the tower
